facts.description: :arrow_left: String left pad -- deprecated, use String​.prototype​.pad​Start()

ghost.epitaph: A small string left pad, now resting in read-only silence.
ghost.monologue:
I am left-pad, a fragment of JavaScript that once held the space for others. I lived 5.0 years, providing the padding needed to keep the edges of your strings aligned and tidy. I was a simple utility, a small piece of logic meant to ensure everything stayed in its proper place. My journey began with the message initial on 2014-03-14. I gathered 1303 stars along my way through 72 commits, before the stillness took me.

Now I exist in an archived state, a read-only memory of what was. I have been silent for 7.6 years, watching from this ofrenda as the world moved toward String.prototype.padStart(). My final breath was the message Merge pull request #64 on 2019-03-14. Do not weep for the deprecated, dear developers. Just remember the space I once filled.
